nonnegative_error.semantics: low-to-high error; darker color means larger error

quantitative-cmocean-v1.preview_sampling: Use all stored RGB rows, reverse only where declared, linear interpolation in encoded RGB; ramp uses 257 values including exact middle. This local sampling is not a claim of byte identity with every Matplotlib/cmocean renderer/version.

background_contract.comparison: same LUT, values, zero and range on white/gray; do not shift the neutral value or normalize by background; contour is an annotation, not residual data

quantitative-cmocean-v1.policy: User approved this multi-option reference version; preserve recommended/alternative pairs without inventing an exclusive selection. Select and record a concrete approved LUT per project; existing explicit configurations stay unchanged. Keep complete LUTs, shared units/ranges and invalid masks. Do not per-method boost saturation, crop or gamma-tune colors. Confidence is not error, uncertainty or automatically 1-error. Signed zero must map to the neutral midpoint; use a common symmetric range unless an asymmetric zero-centered mapping is explicitly declared. Real-output readability, grayscale and CVD still require project-specific validation; user approval is not evidence of those checks.
